title: Synthetic Data Evaluator (sdeval)
summary: A toolkit for evaluating synthetic tabular datasets against real training data, computing statistical fidelity, coverage, privacy, and ML utility metrics via a CLI and Python API. An example script, check_kanaon2.py, trains an SDV CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic data and then runs SDMetrics privacy reports (DiagnosticReport, QualityReport, NewRowSynthesis) against it.
evidence: check_kanaon2.py:82-99: from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer ... model = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata); model.fit(data)
needs: sdeval's core package (sdeval.metrics.*) does not itself import sdv; usage is confined to the example script check_kanaon2.py.
